exercises.instructions: Choose the correct alternative to complete each sentence.

questions.question: It ________ likely that there has been a mistake.
questions.explanation: 'Likely' is an adjective, so we use 'seems' (seems + adjective). 'Likely' က adj ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'seems' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: You ________ be nervous.
questions.explanation: 'Be' is a verb, so we use 'seem to' (seem to + verb). 'Be' က verb ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'seem to' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: He ________ like classical music.
questions.explanation: 'Like' is a verb and 'He' is third person singular, so we use 'seems to' (seems to + verb). 'Like' က verb ဖြစ်ပြီး 'He' က third person singular ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'seems to' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: She doesn't ________ be upset.
questions.explanation: After 'doesn't', we use the base form. 'Be' is a verb, so we use 'seem to'. 'doesn't' ပြီးနောက်မှာ base form 'seem to' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: They ________ rich.
questions.explanation: 'Rich' is an adjective and 'They' is plural, so we use 'seem' (seem + adjective). 'Rich' က adj ဖြစ်ပြီး 'They' က plural ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'seem' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Jane ________ tired.
questions.explanation: 'Tired' is an adjective and 'Jane' is third person singular, so we use 'seems' (seems + adjective). 'Tired' က adj ဖြစ်ပြီး 'Jane' က third person singular ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'seems' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Do they ________ love cat?
questions.explanation: After 'Do', we use the base form. 'Love' is a verb, so we use 'seem to'. 'Do' ပြီးနောက်မှာ base form 'seem to' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: He ________ have a criminal background.
questions.explanation: 'Have' is a verb and 'He' is third person singular, so we use 'seems to' (seems to + verb). 'Have' က verb ဖြစ်ပြီး 'He' က third person singular ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'seems to' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: She ________ excited about her job.
questions.explanation: 'Excited' is an adjective and 'She' is third person singular, so we use 'seems' (seems + adjective). 'Excited' က adj ဖြစ်ပြီး 'She' က third person singular ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'seems' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: They ________ young. How old are they?
questions.explanation: 'Young' is an adjective and 'They' is plural, so we use 'seem' (seem + adjective). 'Young' က adj ဖြစ်ပြီး 'They' က plural ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'seem' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: The soup ________ be cold.
questions.explanation: 'Be' is a verb and 'The soup' is third person singular, so we use 'seems to' (seems to + verb). 'Be' က verb ဖြစ်ပြီး 'The soup' က third person singular ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'seems to' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: He ________ be their father.
questions.explanation: 'Be' is a verb and 'He' is third person singular, so we use 'seems to' (seems to + verb). 'Be' က verb ဖြစ်ပြီး 'He' က third person singular ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'seems to' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: She ________ to cry a lot. Is she OK?
questions.explanation: The sentence already has 'to' after the blank, so we use 'seems'. The structure is 'seems to cry'. 'to' ကို ဘာသာစကားထဲမှာ ထည့်ပြီးသားဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'seems' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Mark ________ have finished the project.
questions.explanation: 'Have finished' is a verb phrase and 'Mark' is third person singular, so we use 'seems to' (seems to + verb). 'Have finished' က verb phrase ဖြစ်ပြီး 'Mark' က third person singular ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'seems to' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Does she ________ angry?
questions.explanation: After 'Does', we use the base form 'seem'. 'Angry' is an adjective, so we use 'seem' (seem + adjective). 'Does' ပြီးနောက်မှာ base form 'seem' ကိုသုံးပါ။
